title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 089
review_goal: Differentiate suitcase, sun, and t shirt variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Briefcase body with one top handle and two horizontal bands across the front panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the luggage to feel flatter and more like a briefcase with front bands.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the taller suitcase when the case should not be framed by two vertical side rails.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is wider and flatter with horizontal front bands instead of the upright travel case proportions.

items.depicts_observation: Round sun circle with short rays spaced evenly around the outer rim
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the standard sun symbol with a central disk and evenly spaced rays.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the wrapped sun when a sweeping ring line should cut through the disk from the left side.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses the classic disk and ray pattern without the extra wrapping line of the second sun variant.

items.depicts_observation: Round sun disk crossed by one sweeping ring line that wraps through the left side
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the sun to feel more stylized with a ring line sweeping through the disk.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the classic sun when the icon should only rely on short rays around a plain center disk.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds the wrapping ring line and drops the simple ray pattern of the first sun variant.

items.depicts_observation: T shirt silhouette with short sleeves and side panels and one rounded collar opening
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a fuller shirt body with extra side panel detail built into the silhouette.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plainer tee when the shirt should not emphasize extra side panels or outer seam structure.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a more structured shirt body with side panel detail instead of the plainer tee outline.

items.depicts_observation: Plain t shirt silhouette with short sleeves and one simple crew neck opening
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the simplest tee outline without extra side panel structure or shaping.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the paneled shirt when the body should show more structure around the sides and shoulders.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the tee simpler and more uniform than the more structured paneled t shirt variant.
